section_summary.extract_value: This section (2.2.2) describes the measurement of self-esteem using the Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale (RSES), a 10-item instrument rated on a 4-point scale. The Polish adaptation by Łaguna et al. (2007) was used, with a reported Cronbach's alpha of .85 in the present study. No participant demographics, sample characteristics, or body appreciation/BMI data are provided in this methods subsection.
